card.name: Word just before "pregnant"
card.fires_on: The word right before "pregnant", mainly "not" in "verify that the patient is not pregnant", and "become" or "becoming" in warnings about pregnancy.

modes.label: Verify not pregnant
modes.description: The word "not" after "is" or "are" in instructions to confirm a patient is not pregnant before starting treatment.
modes.example: Verify that females of reproductive potential are<< not>> pregnant prior to initiating ATEBRIO

modes.label: Become pregnant
modes.description: "Become" or "becoming" in warnings about avoiding or having pregnancy during therapy.
modes.example: Patients should be advised to avoid<< becoming>> pregnant.

card.writes: It makes the next word "pregnant" or a related pregnancy term more likely and suppresses words about birth.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "pregnant" in pregnancy-testing and pregnancy-avoidance warnings.
